notes.title: Update 0.6.6
notes.notes:
List of changes

Features:
- Controller support (xbox, steam controller symbols)
- Aim assist (toggle in gameplay settings)
- Steam cloud support

Tweaks & Fixes:
- Bird collision fix
- Bird gib spawn fixed
- Dupe can glitch fixed
- Decreased zed fitness heal amount
- Increased initial headhunter amount
- Aftertaste (instakill) effect is now blue and less view restrictive
- Quit game on pause and death screen returns to main menu
- UI elements no longer overlay on pause screen
- Some Audio not bound to SFX channel
- Auto equip SMG now works
- Skip text now bound to more buttons
- Added skip initial Warning message
- melee trail appears
- monkeys are no longer active in pause
- Bullets are no longer active on pause
- Ghost sometimes gets stuck on stairs fix
- Improvements to enemy pathfinding
- Text appears faster on name select and ritual select
- Some additional lines added to dog at the end
- Viewport texture fix on loading screen indicator (this could potentially be what's causing the weird purple bug)
- Tutorial screen updates mapping and shows controller bindings if controller in use
- On progress selected Dog can still be heard panting in the loading screen


I'll be working on a big content update this will include

- Additional level gen elements
- Break out level
- Additional enemies
- Additional Perks/Better balancing
- Additional Rituals
- Endless mode
- Steam achievements
- Translations
- More unlockables

You can find a public Trello of upcoming changes here
Public Roadmap

Thank you all for the ongoing support and feedback!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.6.5
notes.notes:
Some small fixes

- Weapon break sound a tad louder
- level transition to dog room smoothed out
- Speed lines effect after death don't reset properly
- Potential fix for some shaders bugging out and turning purple

notes.title: Hotfix 0.6.4
notes.notes:
Some quick issues resolved from feedback

Tweaks:
- Ranged melee weapons are only available in the no firearms mode

Fixes:
- Spider poison UI effect doesn't clear if you die with it active

notes.title: Update 0.6.3
notes.notes:
List of changes

Features:
- you can now pick up enemy ranged weapons and use them as melee
- Blood UI effect on melee hit
- Riot enemies now drop batons (you can use them a melee weapons)
- Restart on pause menu


Tweaks & Fixes:
- Ghosts and Enemies won't spawn right behind doors
- Bird movement and bobbing speed decreased
- Closets and toilet door frame texture fix
- Fixed Sometimes the swoosh effect of a melee weapon still shows when melee is thrown
- Increased punch speed
- updated visuals on melee health bar
- Fixed rare chance enemies stopped spawning on level 10 right at the end


more to come!
